screen.title: Bills to review
screen.intro: Bills from your email that weren't split automatically. Pick the flat and split it, or dismiss it.
screen.emptyBody: Bills from your email that can't be split automatically will wait here.

reasons.NOT_A_BILL: This doesn't look like a bill.
reasons.UNREADABLE: The bill couldn't be read — it may be a password-protected file. Type the amount in.
reasons.NO_AMOUNT: The amount couldn't be read. Type it in.
reasons.NO_FLAT: There's no open flat to split it in.
reasons.AMBIGUOUS_FLAT: It isn't clear which flat this is for. Adding each flat's address helps next time.
reasons.UNKNOWN_SENDER: The sender isn't a known utility, so it wasn't split without a check.
reasons.RECURRING_CONFLICT: This flat already has a fixed repeating bill of this kind. Splitting this too would charge twice.
reasons.CURRENCY_MISMATCH: The bill is in a different currency from the flat.

pending.one: {count} bill from your email to review
pending.other: {count} bills from your email to review

banner.reconnect: Gmail needs connecting again to keep fetching bills.

gmail.unavailable: Gmail isn't set up on this server yet.
gmail.intro: Connect Gmail and utility bills — electricity, water, arnona, internet — are read and split for you. Read-only: nothing is sent, and only the details of bills are kept.
gmail.reconnectNote: Google stopped accepting this connection. Connect again to keep fetching bills.
gmail.resultConnected: Gmail is connected. New bills are fetched whenever the app is opened.
gmail.resultDenied: Gmail wasn't connected: access was not allowed.
gmail.resultFailed: Gmail couldn't be connected. Try again.

address.hint: As it appears on the flat's bills, in the same language. It tells which flat a bill from email belongs to.
